Maya: Quick async sync — postmortem action labeling + soft due roundup for INC-901. Need owners confirmed by EOD PST.

Inc-Bot: INC-901 postmortem created and added to tracker https://redwood.atlassian.com/INC-901 (automated)

Tom: I can own the KB draft.

Maya: @Tom can you do KB by Fri 2026-03-26?

Tom: Yep, I can hit 2026-03-26.

Ravi: I will take runbook updates + step-by-step for oncall. Tentative due Tue 2026-03-23. Note: depends on feature flag PR @Grace.

Grace: ACK — will land PR #4521 to unblock the runbook by Mon (2026-03-22) :thumbsup:

Maya: Putting the agreed actions inline to avoid drift:
```
- KB draft: Tom — Due 2026-03-26
- Runbook updates: Ravi — Due 2026-03-23 (depends on PR #4521)
- Rollback test + canary plan: Grace — Due 2026-03-24
- RCA writeup (root cause + mitigation): Leah — Due 2026-03-25
```

Leah: I can do the RCA write, aiming 2026-03-25. Will ping for quick review.

Tom: Small ask — include token-cost appendix and example logs, will loop @Leah for RCA context.

Grace: PR merged to staging but GPU node test failing intermittently, investigating error: `nvmlDeviceGetComputeRunningProcesses failed`. Will update by EOD.

Ravi: If the GPU regression blocks runbook verification, we should set a "soft due" and continue docs. Maya, want me to shift runbook due to 2026-03-30 as fallback?

Maya: Yes — keep owners as listed but mark Runbook updates as "soft due" 2026-03-30 if GPU issue persists. Escalate to infra-sre if still failing by 2026-03-23.

Leah: Noted. I'll leave RCA review open for Tom and Grace.

Inc-Bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-22 09:00 PST -> owners: Tom, Ravi, Grace, Leah.

Tom: Thanks — starting outline now, will post first draft in this thread when ready.
